notes: Token in src/Token.sol is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named imdUSD (IMDUSD) with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. The pool uses the requested paired currency with a 0.3% fee and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with Token as currency0. The deployer derives the actual opening price from the economics and totalSupply using the deployed currency ordering.
